intent: To illustrate the deep partisan divide in public confidence in police officers, demonstrating that Republicans are significantly more likely to have high confidence than Democrats.

requirements.question: Must the video explicitly rank Republicans/Lean Rep above Democrats/Lean Dem, rather than only showing two separate values?
Should the video state the Republican/Lean Rep relative value itself, not just its higher rank?
Should the video state the Democratic/Lean Dem relative value itself, not just its lower rank?

units.claim: Republicans/Lean Rep rank higher than Democrats/Lean Dem in relative confidence in police officers.

basis.note: higher of the two relative values
lower of the two relative values

accept: Rep/Lean Rep is higher than Dem/Lean Dem
Republicans and Republican leaners are more likely than Democrats and Democratic leaners to have high confidence
the Republican/Lean Rep relative value is above the Democratic/Lean Dem relative value
units.evidence: Both groups must be identifiable, and their displayed relative values must let a viewer determine that the Republican/Lean Rep value is greater than the Democratic/Lean Dem value.

units.claim: The Republican/Lean Rep relative confidence value is approximately 0.466 and is the highest of the two groups.

basis.note: highest relative value in the table

accept: the Republican/Lean Rep relative score is approximately 0.466
units.evidence: The Republican/Lean Rep relative value must be visible or inferable as the largest of the two displayed values.

units.claim: The Democratic/Lean Dem relative confidence value is approximately 0.144 and is the lowest of the two groups.

basis.note: lowest relative value in the table

accept: the Democratic/Lean Dem relative score is approximately 0.144
units.evidence: The Democratic/Lean Dem relative value must be visible or inferable as the smallest of the two displayed values.

optional_valid: An optional annotation showing the exact table decimals 0.4659 and 0.1442.
An optional statement that the Democratic/Lean Dem value is less than one-third of the Republican/Lean Rep value, since 0.1442 / 0.4659 is about 0.31.
An optional note that the Republican/Lean Rep value is more than double the Democratic/Lean Dem value.
